title: Pan2023: Cross-session motor imagery dataset from Pan et al. 2023
description: A cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 14 healthy participants who performed cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery on two separate days. EEG was recorded from 28 channels at 250 Hz, with 120 trials per session (60 per class). The dataset supports research on brain-computer interface decoding and cross-session generalization.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier from 28 channels in a 10-10 montage at 250 Hz, with a nose reference and forehead ground. Each session had four blocks of 30 trials. Each 7 s trial consisted of a 1 s preparation, a 4 s motor imagery period guided by a left- or right-handed rowing game animation with sound, and a 2 s rest.
